rows.note: Use 肚 as the all-purpose colloquial noun for the belly or abdominal area, and for a nontechnical reference to the stomach.

example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 tou5 jau5 di1 tung3

rows.note: Use 肚腩 for the slice of sense 0 involving a noticeably protruding or fat belly.

example.english: My belly has gotten much bigger.
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 tou5 naam5 daai6 zo2 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use 胃 when you mean the stomach specifically as a digestive organ rather than the general belly area.

example.english: After eating so much spicy food, my belly can't take it.
example.traditional: 食咁多辣嘢，我個胃頂唔順。
example.jyutping: sik6 gam3 do1 laat6 je5 ngo5 go3 wai6 ding2 m4 seon6
